reviewed_contracts: Static TOBJ affine UV transform matches source MakeTextureMtx order, signs, repeat factors, zero-scale epsilon, and mirror-T phase; opt-in leaves dense actors/effects unchanged.
Canonical texture coordinate/color metadata survives serialized caches, packed sidecars, and direct/packed material group loads.

Shipping arena marker triggers ten source rebuilds plus Wildlands reuse; captured delivered checkpoint triggers Water/Deep only with nine arena/sidecar reuses; exact prior global metadata permits two Relic scenes; source/sidecar/late-state failures retain retry eligibility.
Trainer opaque/translucent draw aliases retain original source group order for native frame buffers and release ownership; shader helper defaults and old-cache Nascour wraps are isolated.
Shared actor idle notifications, queued terminal clocks, and sparse loop seams preserve source state; particle Prim/Env opacity, active ribbon range, and keyed effect tint/reset are consistent.
Low source ground-shadow exceptions remain venue- and geometry-scoped, with matching direct and packed filters.

Orre camera data keeps the default and guarded lens inside its source rock perimeter; actual doubles Presenter anchors, shared guards, eight default azimuths and native/event shots have targeted framing coverage.

Static native JOBJ instances submit their referenced subtree independently using instance.world * inverse(target.world); unresolved targets and budget failures propagate instead of publishing partial arenas; actor extraction stays opt-out.
Red victory retains its terminal semantic event but selects neutral native idle and zero source gesture weights on both trainer sides; other trainers and Red throw/defeat retain their source tracks.
limitations: DoublesDisplayCompatTests requires unavailable original cbe1/cbe2/cbe3 producer fixtures; no substitute snapshots were represented as historical validation.
Native integration uses the actual engine with its instrumented graphics and in-memory filesystem; it is not GPU rendering or live gameplay.

Separate source/GPU reports cover desktop visual evidence. Android hardware, every move in live singles/doubles battles, full GX TEV chains and native animation controllers were not validated by this review.
